candidateRules: every numeric value stays inside the range the eight classic templates and three overlays already cover (template rule 1); enum values are existing values
the resolved engine knobs of every candidate differ from every other template's resolved knobs (template rule 3)
only the declared fields differ from the template (V2)
thresholds: the G-A8 rules, unchanged: STOP = win rate >= 0.60 and lower 95% bound > 0.55; WARN strong >= 0.57; WARN weak <= 0.43; control 0.50 +/- 0.05
selectionRule: a candidate qualifies only inside the band 0.43 < win rate < 0.57 for both kinds (an overshoot to the other WARN side never qualifies)

SELECTED: the first qualifying candidate in the listed order (smaller change first) with 0.45 <= win rate <= 0.55; a qualifying candidate only in 0.43-0.45 or 0.55-0.57 => SELECTED_BORDERLINE (winner's-curse margin: a point just inside the band has a large chance of WARN again on 400 confirmatory seeds); none => NO_CANDIDATE
the order within a template is A, B, C as listed (A is the smallest change)

a template whose BASE arm has no flag on the screening seeds gets verdict NOT_REPRODUCED (the screened candidate is still reported as screenedCandidate); its proposal is no change and the confirmatory G-A8 decides, unless the Owner prefers the screened candidate

the selection is a proposal for the Owner, not a fix; the selected values must be confirmed by a full G-A8 run on the reserved fresh seeds 43001-43400 with the original thresholds after an Owner-approved, versioned template change
report: per arm: win rate, 95% CI, G-A8 label, blue / red halves, STANDARD / SWAPPED split, median duration; paired difference to STD for every arm (BASE included)
per candidate: paired difference to its BASE arm with 95% CI (the expected-impact estimate)
per template: reproduction status of BASE vs the committed G-A8 label, verdict and selected / screened candidate
multiplicity: 23 arms on one seed block; intervals are unadjusted 95%

validation.V1: the STD and every BASE arm on the first 10 screening seeds reproduce the same configs through the binding path (tacticInputOf template with no choices): win and duration identical
validation.V2: every candidate is valid, inside the shipped range, distinct after resolution, and differs from its template only in the declared fields
validation.V3: every candidate resolves to engine knobs that differ from its BASE (non-vacuous); the live probe covers retreatAt, laneOffset, engageBias, retreatFloorShift, commitShift and also gankWeights, gankIntervalK, phaseEngage, phaseJoin, dragonJoin, baronJoin so content-field changes are seen in the engine; on 2 seeds per candidate the engine t=0 values equal the expectation

liveCheck: every record: balanceTool.v21, Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, skills on, talents off, and the t=0 Director probe equals the arm's expectation; any mismatch => HALT
errors: errored matches are never retried; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
